css: .cb-av.cb-mc{padding:0; background:none;} .cb-av.cb-mc::after{content:''; position:absolute; inset:-30px; z-index:2; background:var(--mc) 50% 50%/100% 100% no-repeat; pointer-events:none;} #chatbox > p.cb-m:has(> .cb-mc){margin-top:34px!important;} .cb-tx.ba-m{border-color:transparent; border-radius:11px; margin:4px 0 6px;} .cb-tx.ba-m::after{content:none;} .cb-tx.ba-m::before{content:''; top:-17.5px; right:-17.5px; bottom:-17.5px; left:-17.5px; border:32px solid transparent; border-image:var(--ba) 64 / 32px round stretch; font-size:0; -webkit-text-stroke:0;} .cb-tx.ba-m.ba-l::after{content:''; position:absolute; z-index:1; top:0; bottom:0; left:-17.5px; right:-17.5px; background:var(--bl) left 4.5px center/26px 26px no-repeat, var(--bl) right 4.5px center/26px 26px no-repeat; font-size:0; -webkit-text-stroke:0;}
